comparison.objective: Lower a hoisted motor onto four base studs while operating the hoist and steering the suspended load.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual pendant operation, pendulum-load guidance, multi-stud alignment, and pinch-zone avoidance.
comparison.success_condition: All feet are flat with four studs through, chain slack, controls released, and no under-load, pinch, or high-speed stud strike violation.
comparison.reason: This tests safe placement of a suspended heavy load onto a four-fastener pattern, not tool-mediated notch fracture or loose-fragment containment.
